event: Peter Todd posts the challenge on BitcoinTalk and funds 6 bounty scripts (5 hash functions plus a non-hash OP_ABS demo)
the non-hash OP_ABS demo bounty is claimed same day (about 5.5 hours after the post)
Stevens et al. publish the first full SHA-1 collision ("SHAttered")
the SHA-1 bounty is claimed on-chain with the SHAttered pair
SHA-256 RIPEMD-160 HASH160 and HASH256 remain unclaimed and unspent
